headline: 丹麥失憶驚悚片新評
context: 丹麥驚悚片《The Secret Woman》改編自小說，講述一名失憶女子發現自己真實身份的故事，評論認為劇情說服力不足。同一天，作曲家 Donnacha Dennehy 的新專輯《Limina》也獲得不錯評價。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: In spite of capable performances and deployment of hygge , gothic and Nordic noir elements, you’ll search for a feasible plot or a character insight in vain Adapted from the 2017 novel by Anna Ekberg (actually a male writing duo), this thriller from Denmark chucks in a bit of everything into the mix: hygge lakeside melodrama, manor-house gothic, and Nordic-noir corruption. But this franticness can’t disguise that it’s a dopey and facile thriller that, despite capable performances, plumbs neither its characters’ depths nor hits thematic pay dirt. It also merits a stiff investigation from the plotting police. Despite amnesia that leaves her unable to remember her life prior to running an idyllic Norwegian rural cafe, Louise (Natalie Wolfsberg Madueño) is gearing up to get hitched to crime writer Joachim (Pål Sverre Hagen). When a tourist approaches and calls her by another name, she is sufficiently shaken to take a DNA test; it confirms she is actually Helene Söderberg, a Danish shipping heiress presumed dead, with a husband and son back home. Originally found stowed away on a cargo ship, she handed over an ID card – for Louise Anderson – which the authorities accepted. Now wanting to reclaim her identity, she pitches up on the capacious doorstep of company executive Edmund (Claes Bang), her former partner. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: McCarthy/Waarts/National Symphony Orchestra Ireland/McAdams (Nonesuch) Dennehy’s Limina, based on areas of the body, is firmly grounded in the harmonic series, and sparklingly executed here, while Stephen Waarts gives a bravura performance of the Violin Concerto These two concertos, beautifully paired, again find Donnacha Dennehy writing music that is both firmly grounded – both rhythmically and in his fascination with the harmonic series – and, to the ear at least, joyously unfettered. Limina was written in 2023 for the pianist Eliza McCarthy , who is a powerhouse soloist here with the National Symphony Orchestra Ireland and conductor Ryan McAdams . It’s a serious piece born of a slightly playful idea. Its three movements are each named for a part of the body, staking out one area before moving to the threshold, or limina, of the next. Head starts with synapses firing high up the keyboard in sparks and glitter; it travels downwards, frenetic energy dissipating, towards Chest, which evokes breathing – not with regular rhythms but with gentle palindromic phrases that swell in and out and sigh back towards the same bass pitch. Nervous System begins deep in the gut, with coarser sounds – low piano vamping, and slapped bowing from the strings – but eventually escapes its tether and disperses around the keyboard. The Violin Concerto, written in 2020, is just as propulsive, and the outer movements especially are a workout for Stephen Waarts , who gives a bravura performance. In the middle movement his violin soars, pushing off from the orchestral support to trace slow, weightless somersaults in the air. The finale has a thrilling sense of motion creating its own gravity: as with so much of Dennehy’s writing, it’s as if the music is held together by centrifugal force. Continue reading...
sources.title: Donnacha Dennehy: Limina album review – joyously unfettered music is a thrill in motion

丹麥驚悚片新評：失憶女子的雙重身份

丹麥驚悚片《The Secret Woman》講述一名失去記憶的女子，原以為自己在挪威經營鄉間咖啡館，卻被驗出是失蹤多年的丹麥船運女繼承人。

評論認為，即使演員表現到位，這部片的劇情仍難以說服人。同一天，作曲家 Donnacha Dennehy 的新專輯《Limina》獲得好評，評論形容其音樂「奔放又扎實」。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 28 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
丹麥驚悚片《The Secret Woman》講述一名失去記憶的女子，原以為自己在挪威經營鄉間咖啡館，卻被驗出是失蹤多年的丹麥船運女繼承人，決定回頭向前伴侶討回自己的身份。評論認為，即使演員表現到位，劇情本身仍禁不起推敲。

同一天，作曲家 Donnacha Dennehy 的新專輯《Limina》獲得好評。專輯以身體部位為三個樂章命名，評論形容這部作品「奔放又扎實」，小提琴協奏曲的演出尤其精彩。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 28 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有一部丹麥驚悚片，劇情比評價還站不住腳——一名失憶女子，原本以為自己只是在挪威開間鄉間咖啡館，結果被驗出其實是失蹤多年的丹麥船運女繼承人，於是回頭向前伴侶討回自己的身份。評論說，演員表現到位，但劇情經不起細看。同一天，有一張新專輯獲得好評，是作曲家 Donnacha Dennehy 的《Limina》，三個樂章分別以身體部位命名，評論形容它奔放又扎實，特別是小提琴協奏曲的部分。
